Shrimp Broccoli Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:35am

Ingredients




1 1/2 lbs. cooked shrimp, peeled
4 (10 oz.) boxes chopped broccoli, steamed or cooked slightly
1 stick butter
2 cans cream of shrimp soup
6 (3 oz.) pkgs. cream cheese with chives

Preparation

1 Let butter and cream cheese come to room temperature. Cream together and add soup. Put broccoli into greased casserole dish, 9"x13". Add shrimp and then pour sauce over all. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
